vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Pack baked products against supplied product and container instructions.
requirements.zh: 依据提供的产品及容器说明包装烘焙产品。

requirements.en: Check supplied labels and escalate mismatches without changing approved ingredient wording.
requirements.zh: 检查提供的标签并上报不匹配问题，不修改获批配料措辞。

requirements.en: Maintain route-level dispatch counts and distinguish dispatched items from remaining stock.
requirements.zh: 维护路线层面的发货数量，并区分已发出物品与剩余库存。

requirements.en: Complete specified weight checks and maintain clear packing records.
requirements.zh: 完成指定重量抽查，并维护清晰包装记录。

requirements.en: Preferred, not required: a current external food-handler credential.
requirements.zh: 优先但非必需：当前有效的外部食品操作人员证书。
